description: Sir Fluffington learned to fetch, but only pinecones
body: Taught Sir Fluffington to fetch. He brings back pinecones and nothing else, and toasts them first.
A goblin that gets into the cottage through the chimney and steals socks.

description: Chimney goblin got in for the first time and stole eleven socks
body: Woke to soot on the hearth and eleven socks gone from the drying rack. A goblin came down the chimney in the night; Sir Fluffington chased it back up.
Roofers and chimney sweeps in Puddingshire, run by Old Man Thatch.

description: Roof leaked over the reading nook; Thatch & Sons patched the thatch for $210
body: Rain came through the thatch over the reading nook. Thatch & Sons came the same afternoon and patched it: $210, paid on the spot.
